info.name: Vim Invitations API
info.description:
# 🚀 Get started here

This template guides you through Vim Invitations API operations

#### **Step 1: Obtain an access token**

Use [this request](https://galactic-resonance-895180.postman.co/workspace/My-Workspace~88a102d1-9a43-4051-8fef-7445298921e3/request/24884677-654890d9-34db-4322-93fb-dd7bc128d50c?action=share&source=copy-link&creator=24884677&ctx=documentation) to obtain an access token.

Make sure to fill your client_id and client_secret body parameters.

For more info see [Vim API docs #obtain-token](https://docs.getvim.com/api/#post-oauth-token)

#### **Step 2: Send the invitation**

Use [this request](https://galactic-resonance-895180.postman.co/workspace/My-Workspace~88a102d1-9a43-4051-8fef-7445298921e3/request/24884677-e5999ef3-2f72-4c65-8e5a-a14f8b78f5d5?action=share&source=copy-link&creator=24884677&ctx=documentation) to send an invitation.

Make sure to set the authorization header with the token obtainened from step 1 and fill the body parameters.

For more info see [Vim API docs #post-invitation](https://docs.getvim.com/api/#post-invitations)

A successful POST request typically returns a `200 OK` or `201 Created` response code.
